audit_coverage.defect_1_canonical_event_envelopes: Every record is an isolated literal chain of exact nine-field Event envelopes; Event.from_mapping and verify_events must accept it.
audit_coverage.defect_2_product_feasible_terminal_shape: Every EXPERIMENT_TERMINATED payload is emitted by the current ResearchService _terminate shape and its retryable value is derivable from status/reason/error.
audit_coverage.defect_3_generic_terminal_states: Every generic canonical terminal state and every storage-boundary alias is a literal EXPERIMENT_STATUS_CHANGED history with a valid typed registration.
audit_coverage.defect_4_generic_defaults: Generic status-only evidence freezes reason, verification, metric, numeric, gate, retryability, and authority defaults without borrowing narrative fields.
audit_coverage.defect_5_nonterminal_boundary: RUNNING is a literal EXPERIMENT_STATUS_CHANGED control and creates no diagnosis obligation.

policy.history_verifier: verify_events(Event.from_mapping(event) for event in canonical_history, project_id=project_id)
policy.artifact_payload_contract: ArtifactRecord.from_mapping(payload); authorized_action is ignored by ArtifactRecord and must be literal null
